messages:
claire_cs: Heads-up — GaleCorp onboarding: p95 on /chat jumping to ~1.8s in peak (10:12–10:22). Seeing repeated long system prompts + short completions. Proactive ops recs incoming.

dmitri_re: Do we have traces or sample requests?

claire_cs: Perf board with traces: https://redwood.app/boards/gale/metrics (look at span id 0x7f3). Spike correlates with >600 token prompts that share identical instructions.

kevin_eng: Quick thought: two levers — reduce model latency for short outputs & avoid recomputing shared prefixes. Concrete: route long-context prompts to larger model, short/templated prompts -> smaller distilled model; enable prefix/KV caching for identical instruction prefixes.

eli_se: +1. We should canary traffic split by prompt_token_count. Example rule I can push to router: 
```
if (prompt_tokens <= 512) -> model: gale-small-distill-8bit
else -> model: gale-large-fp16
```
Canary 10% -> small for 48h.

claire_cs: Also recommend bumping cache TTL for instruction prefix keys to 6h for this account (their templates are stable). Might shave 30–60ms on many calls.

kevin_eng: Will do. Additional infra note: small model will be 8-bit quant (INT8) to save latency/cost. I'll run a short eval to measure quality delta on their dev prompt set. Expect <3% F1 drop for completions, should be acceptable.

dmitri_re: Cache change requires LRU size bump to 64MB on the node group serving Gale. CPU impact minimal per our sim. I'll approve if kevin gives go.

opsbot: deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for route "gale_chat_v1" — 10% -> gale-small-distill-8bit. Canary id: cb-202615. Rolling out KV-cache TTL change as feature-flag GA: false.

claire_cs: Nice. Also flagging renewal_team: lowering p95 & demoing ~20% cost reduction should materially reduce churn risk. I'll draft a one-pager for AM.

kevin_eng: Running A/B now (10k samples). Will post quality/latency deltas here when done. Initial expectation: p95 down ~350ms, cost/unit down ~18%.

eli_se: I'll book a 30-min sync with Gale (Tue 9am PT) to show the tradeoffs and get approval for permanent routing.

dmitri_re: Approved to bump LRU; prepping config change.

monitor-bot: monitor-bot: Alert rule created -> channel #eng-oncall + #customer-success: p95(gale_chat_v1) > 1.5s for 5m.

claire_cs: Action items: kevin -> finish A/B & post results; dmitri -> LRU change; eli -> customer sync; I'll prepare renewal note. Thanks team :thumbsup:

kevin_eng: Will report back by EOD tomorrow.

eli_se: Got it, calendar invite shortly.

opsbot: deploy-bot: Canary at 10% stable for 30m, no errors.

claire_cs: Great — closing loop once kevin posts evaluation.
